sealed.title: This page is encrypted
sealed.noKey: This page is encrypted, and this browser has no key to it.
sealed.menuNoKey: This page's menu is encrypted, and this browser doesn't have its key.

editor.lockedText: This browser has no key that opens it — you have no key to any of its areas, and the role that runs it did not get one when it was encrypted. Ask someone with access to its areas to renew the key in the page settings.
editor.title: Title
editor.textSealed: Title and text are encrypted — only people with this page's key can read them; the server doesn't know them.
editor.textAccess: Title and text are read by people with access to this page (the server sees them too, as long as the page is not encrypted).
editor.textPublic: Title and text are public — anyone who opens this address reads them.
editor.subject: Choice on the page
editor.saveFirst: Save the modules first — the map connects to modules that are already on the page.

public.laterText: This page will appear after the event ends.

public.sealedText: You have access to it, but this browser doesn't have the key that opens it yet. People with access to the page's areas have the key — after signing in or through an access link. A person from a form gets it when someone from the office passes access on to them.

widget.notHere: This module is not on this page.

json.emptyPlaces: Without a file, places stay empty: {names} — add the files below or later in the editor.

json.chooseArea: Choose the area that receives the new form's answers — without it, its questions and requirements won't be created.
json.lead: The whole page — title, look, menu, logic map and modules with their content (forms with their questions) — as one document. Export, change and import: modules change in place, and registrations, links and the logic map stay.
json.unsaved: Unsaved changes in the editor will be saved together with the import.
json.replace: Replace the page's modules — those not in the document will disappear from the page
json.copies: Modules from other pages as copies (without this they are the same modules — a change in one place changes both)
json.wholePage: This is a whole-page document — import it in “Page JSON” below the modules.
json.otherKind: This is the content of a “{said}” module, and this module is “{here}”.
json.partLead: The content of this module as JSON — to copy, correct or have prepared by an AI. The import changes the draft; “Save modules” saves it.
json.partDone: The content is in the draft — save the modules to keep it.

logicEd.question: question
logicEd.intro: The modules of this page are already on the map (on the right) — each has an input “show when”. On the left add the person's data, in the middle connect them with AND / OR / NOT. You add steps like modules: each step is a row in the “Person's steps” module, in order from top to bottom.
logicEd.help: Click a node to set it up. Connect an output (right dot) to the input of a module or a step (left dot). Several edges into one input — all must be met; whoever wants “or” inserts OR. Delete removes the selected node or edge.
logicEd.preview: Preview — tick what is true about the person
logicEd.noInputs: The map doesn't read any of the person's data yet.
logicEd.partHint: Without edges the module is always visible. With edges — only when all of them are true.
logicEd.message: Instead of the module, when it is hidden (optional)
logicEd.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Booking opens once the details are confirmed.
logicEd.stepGoto: The “Go” button leads to the module
logicEd.stepHint: “done when” — when the step is ticked. “applies when” — when it is on the list at all (without edges: always). If “done” hangs on one mark that the person ticks, the person ticks it with the button at the step.
logicEd.noMarks: This form has no marks — you add them in its “Marks” tab.

is.chosen: True when a person was chosen at the top of the page — from a link or one's own.
is.link: True when the chosen person came through their own link.
is.loggedIn: True when the viewer is signed in and has own persons.
is.registered: True when the person sent this form (an extension too).
is.confirmed: True when the person reviewed and confirmed their data from this form.
is.and: True when all inputs are true.
is.or: True when at least one input is true.
is.not: Inverts: true becomes false and the other way round.

logicEd.hashHint: Only a fingerprint of the value is stored on the map, not the value itself — the page map is public. Letter case and spaces at the edges don't matter.
